steps.content:
Buy from **Ottervale Audio — the second listing (b)**.

The two listings are identical on almost everything:

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones | Same |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Rating | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| Availability / shipping | In stock, free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock, free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| Specs / in the box | 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, carry case, etc. | Same |

The **only difference is the returns policy**, and Ottervale's is clearly better:

* **Brackmoor Sound:** 30-day returns, and *you* pay return shipping
* **Ottervale Audio:** Free 90-day returns

So for the same price, you get 3x as long to decide if the headphones fit/sound right, and you won't have to pay shipping if you do send them back.
